scale_distance_forward.display_name: Find real distance from a map scale

easy.statement_latex: A garden plan uses a scale of $1\text{ inch} = 16\text{ yards}$. Two landmarks are $8$ inchs apart on the garden plan. Determine the real-world distance between them.
hints: Each $inch$ on the garden plan stands for $16$ yards in the real world.
Multiply the drawing distance by the scale factor: $\text{real} = \text{drawing} \cdot k$.
Compute: $8 \cdot 16$.
solution_steps_latex: Set up a proportion using the scale $\dfrac{1\text{ inch}}{16\text{ yards}} = \dfrac{8\text{ inch}}{x\text{ yards}}$.
